# @seekbuddy/dsh-ui
English | 中文
React components in the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web UI design system, for building product pages arou
nd DSH: the DSH primitives (`--dsw-*` design tokens, light / dark themes, controls, icons, Markdown
and tool-output renderers) plus the components DSH does not provide, such as cards, tabs, pagination
, messages, upload and date / time pickers, built on the same tokens. Packaged for ordinary React 18
/ 19 and Next.js apps.
**Live preview:** every component in Storybook.
> **Unofficial.** This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by DeepSeek. It shi
ps no DeepSeek brand assets (logo or wordmark). See THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
## Why this package
The DSH UI primitives (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`) cover what the DSH web shell needs:
chat, tool output, menus, dialogs. A product built around DSH also has consoles, settings and admin
pages, and those need components DSH does not have: cards, tabs, pagination, date and time input, up
load, global messages. Writing them separately in each app drifts away from the DSH look; patching t
hem into a copy of the primitives turns every upstream sync into a merge.
This package provides those components and keeps them apart from DSH:
- **Extension components** (`@seekbuddy/dsh-ui/seekbuddy`) fill the gaps. They are styled only with
the DSH tokens and follow DSH's styling rules, so they sit next to DSH controls without looking diff
erent, and they reuse DSH controls through the public entry instead of re-implementing them. See doc

s/components.
- **The DSH layer** is a copy of the upstream primitives with packaging fixes only, ea
ch recorded in UPSTREAM.md, so it follows upstream tags.
To make the DSH layer usable in an ordinary app, it also fixes three packaging problems of the offic
DSH layer usable in an ordinary app, it also fixes three packaging problems of the official package:
| Official package | `@seekbuddy/dsh-ui` |
| One root entry re-exports everything, so Shiki and KaTeX land in the first page load | Split entri
es; the root entry is guarded at build time against reaching Markdown, Shiki, KaTeX or the code-file

artwork |
| Theme tokens and theme switching live in a Cordis plugin | `tokens.css` and a standalon

e `light / dark / system` theme runtime with a no-flash bootstrap script |
| KaTeX output is convert
ed with the browser-only `DOMParser` | SSR-safe KaTeX rendering; tested with React 18 SSR and a Next
owser-only `DOMParser` | SSR-safe KaTeX rendering; tested with React 18 SSR and a Next.js 16 build |

Peer dependencies: `react` and `react-dom` `^18.2.0 || ^19.0.0`.
## Quick start
Import the global token sheet once, in your app entry. Import `katex.css` only if you render math.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Component styles are CSS Modules compiled into the JavaScript and injected into `<head>` once, the f
irst time a component module loads. `tokens.css` and `katex.css` are the only global stylesheets.
Components contain no user-facing text: every visible or screen-reader label is a prop (usually a ty
ped `labels` object), so you localize them in your app.
## Entry points
Import only from these entries; anything else under `dist/` is internal.
| Entry | Contents |
| `@seekbuddy/dsh-ui` | Lightweight controls and utilities: `Button`, `Input`, `Pill`, `Tag`, `Switc
h`, `Checkbox`, `Menu`, `MenuSurface`, `Modal`, `Tooltip`, `Toast`, `HoverCard`, `SegmentedControl`,
`SegmentedTabs`, positioning / modal hooks, and helpers such as `relativeTime`, `fileSizeText`, `ra

nkByName` |
| `@seekbuddy/dsh-ui/blocks` | Tool-output renderers `TerminalBlock`, `ReadBlock`, `Diff
Block`, `SearchBlock`, `WebBlock`, `JsonTree`; file / link icons `FileTypeIcon`, `LinkIconRegular` /

`LinkIconMedium`; code highlighting `languageForPath`, `useCodeHighlighter` (loads Shiki) |
| `@see
kbuddy/dsh-ui/markdown` | `MarkdownText`, `CodeBlock`, `JsonBlock`, `MarkdownDelegateProvider`, `ext

ractMarkdownPlainText` |
| `@seekbuddy/dsh-ui/icons` | 194 `Icon*` components (97 glyphs × `Regular`

/ `Medium` stroke), `PermissionIcon*`, `ReferenceIcon*`, `PluginArtwork*`, `GuideArtwork*` |
| `@se

ekbuddy/dsh-ui/theme` | Theme state, DOM application and React hooks |
| `@seekbuddy/dsh-ui/theme/bo

otstrap` | `THEME_BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPT`, an inline script with no React dependency |
| `@seekbuddy/dsh-u

i/seekbuddy` | Extra components (docs); the whole entry is a Client Component |
| `@seekbuddy/dsh-ui
/seekbuddy/{card,empty,spinner,timeline}` | Hook-free extra components that a Next.js Server Compone

nt may import |
| `@seekbuddy/dsh-ui/seekbuddy/tabs` | `Tabs`; same as importing it from `/seekbuddy

` |
| `@seekbuddy/dsh-ui/tokens.css` | The eight DSH theme sheets, concatenated in their cascade ord

er |
| `@seekbuddy/dsh-ui/katex.css` | KaTeX CSS reduced to woff2 fonts |
## Two layers
| Layer | Source | Contents |
| DSH layer | `src/` except `src/seekbuddy/` | A copy of the DSH web UI primitives and theme sheets,
kept in sync with upstream tags. Local changes are listed in UPSTREAM.md; everything else is unchan

ged upstream code. |
| Extra components | `src/seekbuddy/` | Components DSH does not provide, writte
n for this package and styled only with `--dsw-*` tokens |
Extra components: `Card`, `Empty`, `Mark`, `MessageProvider` + `useMessage`, `Pagination` (+ `pageIt
ems`), `QrCode`, `Spinner`, `StatusBadge`, `Switch`, `Tabs`, `Timeline`, `Upload`, `DangerButton`, `
SubtleButton`, and the date / time family `Calendar`, `DatePicker`, `DateRangePicker`, `TimePicker`,
`DateField`, `DateRangeField`, `TimeField`. **Each one is documented — usage, examples and the full
API — in docs/components.**
The extra components import DSH components through the public `@seekbuddy/dsh-ui` entry, never by re
lative path. A bundler can therefore alias that entry to another copy of the DSH primitives (for exa
mple the one a DSH web shell already loads), and the page keeps a single implementation of each cont
rol. Importing one component from `/seekbuddy` does not pull in the others: every component is built
into its own chunk, together with its CSS.
